before.capability: Reusable local inspector already integrated into FIELD, HUMAN PORT, Docs and standalone Foundry.
before.risk: Its donors overlap AXIAL, Scale Lens, Two Dial and RSVP; without an explicit charter future work could treat shared visual/control motifs as semantic equivalence.

operation: Declared one-source inspection as APERTURE's bounded function.
Separated APERTURE from Constraint Surface exact-set support, AXIAL categorical orientation, Scale Lens canonical provenance, LensState typed admissibility and STATE APERTURE TEST/ARM/RUN authority.
Recorded host-owned durability: APERTURE emits field-aperture-focus/v0.2 snapshot/session handoff; the host decides whether it becomes durable state.
Added public validation guards for charter presence and semantic boundaries.
Touched the APERTURE manifest route without promoting it beyond UTILITY.

proof.machine: Static/browser/runtime gates already cover current host integrations; charter boundary now has regression assertions.
proof.human: NOT_CLAIMED — comparative reading/inspection usefulness, RSVP comprehension and material-map value remain ordinary-use questions.
proof.concurrent_lens_state: Recent FI Lens mobile RETURN browser proof narrows the same distinction: runtime law can be automated; human comparative advantage remains a separate gate.

non_claims: Radial/material mapping is not semantic importance.
Shared donors do not imply one universal interface.
APERTURE focus snapshot is not canonical truth or actuation permission.
return: APERTURE can now evolve as a reusable inspector without absorbing the neighboring instruments that donated mechanisms.
next: No APERTURE expansion. Reopen only from a concrete inspection failure or ordinary-use evidence; otherwise await issue #8 local ingest return / human use.
